sections.theory:
Key points

Descriptive or qualitative characteristics are called attributes.

For the sake of convenience capital English letters A, B, C… are used to denote presence of attributes and the Greek letters α, β, γ… denote the absence of these attributes respectively.

The classes A, B, AB are called positive classes because they contain the presence of attributes.

The classes α, β, αβ are called negative classes because they contain absence of the attributes.

For attributes class frequencies are denoted by enclosing the class symbols in parentheses.

When a single attribute is under study then simple process of classifying the whole data in two groups is called dichotomy.

The order of a class is determined by the number of attributes present in a class.

The classes and class frequencies of the highest order are called the ultimate classes and ultimate class frequencies.

Association is a statistical technique which measures the strength and direction of relationship among qualitative variables.

(AB)=\frac{(A)(B)}{n}. This is known as criterion of independence for attributes.

Q=\frac{(AB)(\alpha\beta)-(A\beta)(\alpha B)}{(AB)(\alpha\beta)+(A\beta)(\alpha B)} is Yule’s coefficient of association.

When a population or sample is divided into many classes or categories according to an attribute is called multi-way or manifold classification.

A table consisting of r-rows and c-columns into which the data are classified according to two attributes is called (r × c) contingency table.

Chi-square test statistic is used to test the hypothesis about independence of attributes in the contingency tables.

جماعتیں α، β، αβ منفی جماعتیں کہلاتی ہیں کیونکہ ان میں صفات کی غیر موجودگی ہوتی ہے۔

Q=\frac{(AB)(\alpha\beta)-(A\beta)(\alpha B)}{(AB)(\alpha\beta)+(A\beta)(\alpha B)} یول کا تلازم کا سر ہے۔

جب کسی آبادی یا نمونے کو ایک صفت کے مطابق کئی جماعتوں یا زمروں میں تقسیم کیا جائے تو اسے کثیر طرفہ یا متعدد درجہ بندی کہتے ہیں۔

r قطاروں اور c کالموں پر مشتمل جدول جس میں مواد کو دو صفات کے مطابق درجہ بند کیا جائے (r × c) اتفاقی جدول کہلاتا ہے۔

paras.text: i. Data recorded on attributes are called quantitative data.

paras.text: ii. A, B, AB, ABC are called positive classes.
paras.urdu: ii. A، B، AB، ABC مثبت جماعتیں کہلاتی ہیں۔
paras.pashto: ii. A، B، AB، ABC مثبت ټولګي بلل کېږي.

paras.text: iii. (B) + (β) = n

paras.text: iv. If $(AB)=\frac{(A)(B)}{n}$ means A and B are positively associated.

paras.text: v. If Q = 0, then attributes are independent.

paras.text: vi. Relationship between two qualitative variables is called correlation.

paras.text: viii. For a (4 × 5) contingency table the degrees of freedom for $\chi^2$ test is 20.

paras.pashto: viii. د (4 × 5) احتمالي جدول لپاره د $\chi^2$ ازموینې د ازادۍ درجې 20 دي.

paras.text: ix. The range of $\chi^2$ distribution is from 0 to ∞.
paras.urdu: ix. $\chi^2$ تقسیم کی حد 0 سے ∞ تک ہے۔
paras.pashto: ix. د $\chi^2$ وېش حد له 0 تر ∞ دی.

paras.text: x. (2 × 2) contingency table contains 3-rows and 3 columns.

sections.theory:
Exercise

8.1 Mark the following statements as true and false.

i. Data recorded on attributes are called quantitative data.

ii. A, B, AB, ABC are called positive classes.

iii. (B) + (β) = n

iv. If (AB)=\frac{(A)(B)}{n} means A and B are positively associated.

v. If Q = 0, then attributes are independent.

vi. Relationship between two qualitative variables is called correlation.

vii. \chi^2 test has \nu=(r-1)(c-1) df for an (r × c) contingency table.

viii. For a (4 × 5) contingency table the degrees of freedom for \chi^2 test is 20.

ix. The range of \chi^2 distribution is from 0 to ∞.

x. (2 × 2) contingency table contains 3-rows and 3 columns.

8.2 Fill in the suitable words in the blanks.

i. If an attribute has two classes, it is said to be ______.

ii. The number of letters representing a class determines the ______ of the class.

iii. The class represented by AB is of ______ order.

iv. The total of all frequencies n is of order ______.

v. If the attributes A and B are independent, frequency (AB) is equal to ______.

vi. If A and B are independent, Yule’s coefficient of association Q is equal to ______.

vii. Association and correlation are ______.

viii. Yule’s coefficient Q is ranging from ______.

ix. For an (r × c) contingency table, the sum of observed and expected frequencies must be ______.

x. For (5 × 6) contingency table the degree of freedom for \chi^2 test is equal to ______.

مشق

i. صفات پر ریکارڈ کیا گیا مواد مقداری مواد کہلاتا ہے۔

ii. A، B، AB، ABC مثبت جماعتیں کہلاتی ہیں۔

iii. (B) + (β) = n

iv. اگر (AB)=\frac{(A)(B)}{n} ہو تو اس کا مطلب ہے کہ A اور B مثبت طور پر متلازم ہیں۔

v. اگر Q = 0 ہو تو صفات آزاد ہیں۔

vi. دو کیفیتی متغیرات کے درمیان تعلق کو ارتباط کہتے ہیں۔

vii. (r × c) اتفاقی جدول کے لیے \chi^2 جانچ کے \nu=(r-1)(c-1) درجاتِ آزادی ہیں۔
